_comment: Server settings tab. Official servers run a locked preset; 'custom' takes the world's Saved/Worlds/<world>/settings.json {"preset": "custom", "base": "pve", "settings": {...}}. Pick with -wrpreset=<name> or that file (the menu writes it for a new world). Read in code as server.<key>. Playtest = Casual co-op + 10x XP/skills, 10x taming, 1 h boss respawn (internal, build plan M7). Fixed on every server (not settable): 10% boss loot rule, 150-point path cap with 100 per path, artifact rules apply only to the wearer. portalBreak: half / normal / double / never (dungeon portals' real-day break timers); portalRuns: how many portal runs may be open at once (1-8); artifactCap: off / 5 / 10 / 15 (off also closes hidden third phases); artifactSlots: 0-3 hooks. raidGroupMax: the most survivors one war-hall raid lets in (0 = no cap, as DR #22 reads it: tuned for, not capped); raidGroupTuned: the group its champions are balanced for (4-12; endgame raids, shown once they exist). raidRespawnHours: hours before the war-hall champions rise again (1-168). offlineArmMinutes: how long after the last of a claim's owners leaves its offline protection arms (0-60), offlineQuietMinutes: how long a claim must go unattacked before it arms (0-60; cooks/cookpass-multiplayer.md 3.2). recordsSeason: the season of the kill-time boards (a higher number starts new boards; the old ones stay readable).
